meta.note: v2: one token set for the site, the Titan app and the Studio console, plus the brand layer (Hexel Indigo, the Field, Aurora, Scenes, Glass).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page behind everything, in every app: the site's canvas, the Titan app's chat and sidebar, the Studio console's shell. Set `foreground`, `muted-foreground` and the brand `link` on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `secondary` and `muted` (18.6:1 or more in both themes). Headings, titles and body copy.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, table bodies, the launch cards at rest. Edged by a 1px `border` ring, never by a shadow.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Things that float: menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs, the agent window. Always with `shadow-menu` or `shadow-dialog`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one filled ink control per view: the primary pill on the site, the send button in the composer, the main action in a dialog. Never indigo.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and selected rows. `foreground` reads 16.4:1 on it; `muted-foreground` 5.0:1.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: skeleton bars, inline code, table header bands, disabled fields.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `secondary`: meta, captions, descriptions, placeholders. 5.0:1 or better on each, in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlight fill in menus and lists (the gliding highlight). A grey, not a hue: the brand hue is `indigo-500`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card rings, table rules, section rules, dividers.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes). Studio's stronger value is the standard. It does not reach 3:1, so every field also has a visible label and a `ring` focus state.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px outline at 2px offset on every focusable element. 4.7:1 or better on `background` and `card` in both themes.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, errors and destructive menu items. 5.0:1 on `card` in light. Filled buttons with white text use `destructive-solid`.

tokens.name: destructive-solid
tokens.usage: The fill behind white text in a filled destructive button. In dark, #f87178 would give white text only 2.4:1, so the fill is darker (5.6:1).

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: White label text in a `destructive-solid` button (5.0:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: Allowed, Done, Available. 6.0:1 on its own 11% tint.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: Waiting, Expiring, Preview. No yellow fills anywhere else.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons: Waiting for approval, Coming, Notes.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `success` badge.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `warning` badge.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `info` badge.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The site's name for `background`. Pages are set on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The site's name for `foreground`. Headings, titles, body copy, the primary pill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Long-form copy where full ink is too heavy: leads and prose on `canvas` and `paper` (12.9:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted-ink
tokens.usage: The site's name for `muted-foreground`: meta only (eyebrows, dates, captions, `t-small`).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative marks only: ticks, checklist icons, chart gridlines, placeholder glyphs. Never text: it reads 2.3:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The site's name for `card`: white cards with a 1px `line` ring, set against `canvas`.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Secondary fills on the site: the segmented track, quiet launch cards, the secondary pill.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: The deepest grey step, one past `paper-2`: its hover state, stopped or disabled fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The site's name for `border`: section rules, row dividers, card rings.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairlines: outline buttons, kbd keys, inputs on the site.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The app sidebar: the same surface as the page, divided by `sidebar-border`. Studio's #fafafa rail moves to this.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar rows (at 90% in the Titan app; icons at 60%).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill, when one is filled.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: The sidebar's gliding highlight and selected row.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border

tokens.name: sidebar-ring

tokens.name: composer

tokens.name: composer-border

tokens.name: chip

tokens.name: surface-border

tokens.name: voice-surface

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb-hover

tokens.name: brand

tokens.name: indigo-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected row or an indigo badge on light.

tokens.name: indigo-100

tokens.name: indigo-200

tokens.name: indigo-300

tokens.name: indigo-400
tokens.usage: `accent-brand` and `link` in dark: 6.4:1 on #171717, 5.9:1 on #1f1f1f.

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Hexel Indigo, the brand colour. Fills with white text (5.1:1): the active indicator, progress, the brand chip, the deepest stop of the Field. The colour people should remember.

tokens.name: indigo-600
tokens.usage: `link` in light: 6.6:1 against the light `background`, 7.0:1 against white. Light theme only; dark uses `indigo-400`.

tokens.name: indigo-700
tokens.usage: Pressed indigo fills; indigo text on `indigo-50` (8.9:1).

tokens.name: indigo-800
tokens.usage: Deep indigo for illustration and charts' darkest series.

tokens.name: indigo-900
tokens.usage: Near-night indigo: the Field's upper middle, deck backgrounds.

tokens.name: indigo-950
tokens.usage: Night: text on indigo-400 in dark (6.8:1); the top of the Field.

tokens.name: accent-brand
tokens.usage: The UI accent is ink, never a hue: count badges, the `brand` badge's dot, an active marker. Hexel Indigo lives only in the brand's light (Field, Aurora, Silk, scenes), never in UI chrome.

tokens.name: on-accent-brand
tokens.usage: Text or icon on `accent-brand`.

tokens.name: link

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background, in every app. Neutral; the brand hue stays in the gradients.

tokens.name: chart-accent
tokens.usage: The one coloured series in a chart (the metric that matters), sparkline endpoints and meter fills: series blue. The rest stay on the grey `chart-*` ramp.

tokens.name: field-0
tokens.usage: The Field's top stop: night. Text on it is `on-field`.

tokens.name: field-1
tokens.usage: The Field at about a third of its height. Stats and headlines sit here: `on-field` 16.6:1, `on-field-muted` 6.9:1.

tokens.name: field-2
tokens.usage: The Field at two thirds: where the thread art lives.

tokens.name: field-3
tokens.usage: The Field's base: Hexel Indigo.

tokens.name: field-4
tokens.usage: Lilac light rising from the floor of the Field (the glow's edge). Never under text.

tokens.name: field-glow
tokens.usage: The bright core of the floor glow, bottom centre. Never under text.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on the Field: the rules above and below a stat band.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text, icons and threads on the Field and on scenes: headlines, the active stat.

tokens.name: on-field-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the Field: inactive stats, captions. 6.9:1 on `field-1`, 5.9:1 on the mid Field. Keep it above the floor glow.

tokens.name: scene-bloom-1

tokens.name: scene-mint-1

tokens.name: scene-rose-1

tokens.name: glass-edge

tokens.name: glass-ink
tokens.usage: Smoked glass: a panel that holds text over the bright half of a scene, so white text stays above 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-bar
tokens.usage: Skeleton bars inside a glass fragment, standing in for text that is not the point.

tokens.name: status-ok

tokens.name: status-wait

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical chart series 1 (blue). Six rich, even-weight hues with no purple (purple is the brand's gradients only): blue, pink, amber, teal, coral, cyan, in that order. Validated on `card`: worst adjacent CVD ΔE 11.9, normal vision 18.8, every slot at least 3:1 in both themes. Assign in order and never cycle; a seventh series folds into "Other" (`chart-2`). Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical chart series 2 (pink). Assign series in order; a seventh folds into "Other". Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: series-3

tokens.name: series-6

tokens.name: status-good

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Chart marks and dots that mean degraded, waiting, slow (amber). Below 3:1 on `card` in light: always with an icon or label. Fixed across themes; never used for an ordinary series.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Chart marks and dots that mean denied, 4xx, at risk (coral). Always with an icon or label. Fixed across themes; never used for an ordinary series.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Chart marks and dots that mean failed, down, 5xx (rose red). Always with an icon or label. Fixed across themes; never used for an ordinary series.

tokens.name: chart-baseline
